scalars.scalar_value: Training and Experience : Three years of experience in budget and/or fiscal record keeping and reporting, involving manual, machine, and computer accounting systems

items.item_text: 01. These supplemental questions are part of the selection process and are considered part of your application. These questions give you the opportunity to fully explain your background and qualifications as they pertain to this position. Read the following questions and respond to each question thoroughly and accurately. Your answers to the following supplemental questions are required for your application to be considered complete. All experience mentioned in the Supplemental Questions must also be included in the Work Experience section in order to be considered complete. A resume will not be accepted in lieu of completion of the required application or supplemental questions. Resumes are NOT reviewed, therefore information on the resume will not be considered in the screening of the application. NOTE: Be sure to respond honestly and truthfully to all questions. Applicants found to have provided false or misleading information will be disqualified from further consideration, or, if hired, may be terminated from employment. I have read and understand this statement. Options: Yes | No

02. How many years of experience do you have in budget and/or fiscal record keeping and reporting, involving manual, machine, and computer accounting systems? In determining qualifying experience, applicants' part-time employment will only receive partial credit based on the number of hours worked per week. For example, a position that works 40 hours a week for one year would get one year of credit, whereas a position that works 20 hours a week for one year would get six months of credit. Options: No experience | Less than 3 years | At least 3 years, but less than 4 years | 4 years or more

03. In reference to the question above, please provide the following information for EACH organization where you gained experience in budget and/or fiscal record keeping and reporting, involving manual, machine, and computer accounting systems : 1) Your job title 2) Organization name 3) Start and end dates (month/year) and number of hours worked per week 4) Brief description of duties Please write "N/A" if you do not have experience in this area. Do NOT type "see resume."

04. Do you have at least two or more years of experience in the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Finance Department in a lower technical position? In determining qualifying experience, applicants' part-time employment will only receive partial credit based on the number of hours worked per week. For example, a position that works 40 hours a week for one year would get one year of credit, whereas a position that works 20 hours a week for one year would get six months of credit. Options: Yes | No
Training and Experience : Three years of experience in budget and/or fiscal record keeping and reporting, involving manual, machine, and computer accounting systems
two years of experience with Hacienda La Puente Unified School District in the Finance Department in a lower technical position. Educational coursework equal to or more than 16 units desirable.
Makes complex arithmetical calculations and verifies computations.
Assembles, tabulates, checks, and files accounting data in the budget area.
Performs more difficult tasks related to the preparation and management of accounting records and reports, such as federal, county, and state funded programs and general accounting.
Operates a variety of office machines such as copier, typewriter, calculator, personal computer, keyboard terminal and multi-line telephone.
Works with computer-based accounting systems in preparing input to the computer and using output reports.
Establishes and maintains journals, ledgers, and other accounting records.
Prepares, verifies and maintains a wide variety of financial and statistical records and reports.
Compares schedules and completes fiscal records and reports.
Arranges, posts and balances financial data.
Prepares trial balance and financial statements.
Posts to subsidiary ledgers and general ledger.
Assists in the revision, formulation, and implementation of accounting record-keeping systems and procedures.
Works under pressure of constant deadlines with frequent interruptions.
Analyzes and resolves problems with tact and diplomacy.
Recommends and complies with accounting policies that support overall business goals of the District.
Balances specific accounts and computer prepared reports for reporting purposes.
Verifies account strings to proper account.
Provides and prepares documents and explanations to auditors.
Provides senior management, supervisors with accurate and timely account reconciliation.
Provides meaningful analysis of the accounts as requested to site administrators.
Ensures all District deadlines are met.
Trains others on District computer software applications.
Works with construction companies for bond projects.
Establishes regular communication process with District personnel, site administrators, county and state offices and other agencies to facilitate information and learning exchange.
Performs other related duties as required.
